notes: Persist character-form IDs: March 7th and Trailblazer share display names across forms.
Thunder displays as Lightning. Knight→Preservation; Rogue→The Hunt; Shaman→Harmony; Memory→Remembrance. Use paths.json to include new paths.
98 forms is not 98 distinct playable people. Roster presence is not proof of release.
Prevent more than one Trailblazer or March 7th form in one party. No unsupported DPS, best-team or synergy claims.
Count elements and paths; a missing Preservation/Abundance note is a checklist hint, not proof the team cannot survive.
Packaged snapshot should use one commit for characters, paths and elements; fallback gracefully when a refreshed unknown enum appears.
